articles.title: Airbnb CEO says X account was hacked, attacker posted AI-slop on tokenization
articles.snippet: Brian Chesky regained control of his account and told any new crypto followers he would be a "disappointing follow".

articles.title: Bitcoin Q-Day Recovery Proposal Aims to Let Users Prove Ownership After Quantum Attack
articles.snippet: Project Eleven says a new post-quantum cryptographic proof could help Bitcoin users recover wallets after Q-Day by verifying ownership.

articles.title: OpenAI Uses AI Red Team to Strengthen GPT-5.6 Against Prompt Injection Attacks
articles.snippet: OpenAI said its new automated red-teaming model, GPT-Red, uncovered vulnerabilities that were used to make GPT-5.6 more resistant to prompt injection attacks.

articles.title: Another DeFi Exploit: Perp DEX Ostium Loses $18 Million in Oracle Attack
articles.snippet: Hackers manipulated Ostium's price feed by compromising an oracle signer key, allowing them to drain roughly $18 million from the Arbitrum-based perpetuals exchange.
